answer: Convex registration deposits resist sybils: the collateral for each additional identity funded from one settlement rail rises super-linearly, so a thousand fakes drawn from a single ocean of capital cost on the order of N-squared to seat, while N independent honest funders each pay only the flat base. An honest agent locks one deposit in the vault and tends a small garden of standing; a farm sharing a funding source hits a quadratic capital wall. Precondition: registrations traceable to a common funder are priced on the convex curve.
